snippet.title: Beyond 90: A Footballer's Life | One Player. One Career.
snippet.description:
Beyond 90: A Footballer's Life is a football career RPG where you control only yourself. Never the team, never the tactics, never the substitutions.

Wishlist / play it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5330590/Beyond_90_A_Footballers_Life/

Live the life of a footballer, from your first contract at 16 to your final season up to 24 years later. Play every match in real time, earn your place, chase fame, money and love, and face the consequences that follow you beyond the 90 minutes.

What's in the game:
- Real-time, top-down football with hand-drawn pixel-art players
- 15 skills and 14 training drills
- 24 countries, 48 divisions, 775 clubs
- Contracts, agents, transfers and sponsors
- A partner, children, friends, and life events that test your choices
- Or cut corners: betting, bribes, match fixing. Just don't get caught.

The game is out on Steam and open for playtesting. If you find a bug or something feels off, please tell me in the comments or on the Steam page. It really helps.

#BeyondFootball #FootballGame #IndieGame #PixelArt #SteamGames
